cohort: The study included seven patients who had previously undergone gastric bypass and postbariatric fleur-de-lis abdominoplasty, and subsequently became pregnant.
finding: Pregnancy had some influence on abdominoplasty esthetic outcomes, but the impairment was not severe, and pregnancy and delivery in these patients did not present a higher complication rate.
gest_age: full-term, preterm, small for gestational age
